name: Velvet Antenna v0.22.1 Antenna Flow
author: James
description: Major standalone Velvet Antenna viewer release. v0.22.1 keeps Antenna Flow, Tonight, Continue the Story, One More Episode, Forgotten Signals, Rediscover, Signal Match and in-player CC+ subtitle search, while fixing TV navigation at the architecture level: Movies, Series, Collections and other primary libraries are now discovered from Jellyfin User Views rather than relying on Home DOM cards, the top navigation is TV-safe and horizontally focusable, and TV Home gets a redundant remote-first Libraries strip so core destinations cannot disappear.
